guarantees.claim: When Num == 6, the generate block instantiates a wire 'sel_chk' of enum type 'mux6_sel_e' and continuously assigns it the value of 'sel_o' after a type cast.

assumptions.claim: 'sel_o' must carry a bit pattern that encodes a legal member of the 'mux6_sel_e' enumeration, because the cast does not add validity checking.
assumptions.risk: An illegal value on 'sel_o' will cast to an out-of-enum value on 'sel_chk'; downstream logic treating it as a valid enum label may miss the illegal case, leading to undefined or unintended mux control.

uncertain_points.claim: The generate block assigns a type-cast 'sel_chk' from 'sel_o' but contains no assertion that 'sel_o' is within the legal enum set; the intended design‑time check is absent from this code region.
uncertain_points.risk: An illegal selector value may propagate through the cast without detection, potentially misrouting sensitive data blocks in the AES path.
